text:
jon-bizdev: Heads-up: VerdeHealth just signed a 3yr deal that bundles Dedicated capacity + a Private VPC (HIPAA workload). Onboarding kick-off is next Thu 2pm PT. This is a big one — customer requires customer-managed KMS and strict audit retention. Marketing asked for a short case study + exec quote after go‑live. Link to internal win doc (restricted): https://redwood.internal/wins/verdehealth :party_parrot:

maya: Huge — congrats team! :tada:

samir: Awesome news. Quick q: both Dedicated + Private (on‑prem) or Private VPC only? Who's the Verde POC?

jon-bizdev: Both — Dedicated for steady throughput and a Private VPC for PHI handling. Verde ops POC is Laura (I’ll intro before the kickoff). Sales POC is me. We need security & compliance on the KMS/HSM integration and the BAA review before we sign off on deployment.

elaine: I can own the deployment runbook + SLO doc. I'll start a checklist: network peering, route tables, VPC endpoints, audit log sinks, KMS key policy, rotation plan, and BAA artifacts. Will sketch in the onboarding repo.

kevin-sec: Copy — from security/compliance: we need a signed BAA, pen test report (or attestation), and KMS/HSM key lifecycle details. Recommend Private with HSM-backed customer KMS if Verde insists on key isolation. I'll drop a template and the minimum controls list in the kickoff invite. :lock:

jon-bizdev: For the case study, marketing wants a short CTO quote + a 2‑3 line usage blurb (expected qps, avg seq length). Engineering: can we provide a 2‑3 line technical summary + a tiny python snippet for the docs?

samir: Yep — I'll produce perf + cost baselines for g5/g6 style instances and a 3‑line technical blurb. Will include a python example for both generation and embeddings. Example snippet (draft):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="REDACTED")
resp = client.generate(model="rwd-llm-2", prompt="Summarize patient note")
print(resp.text)
```

elaine: Python snippet is perfect. I'll capture deployment latency/cost baseline and a runbook excerpt for the case study appendix. Also logging retention and audit examples.

maya: Marketing note — I'll handle the logo permission and PR timing. Suggest we target a short announcement ~2 weeks after go‑live. Please CC me on any customer comms.

jon-bizdev: Thanks — kickoff invite out (Thu 2pm PT). Agenda: intros, compliance checklist, infra plan, timeline, case study ask. I'll add the internal deck link to the invite. Thread for collab: https://redwood.internal/docs/wins/verdehealth-casestudy-draft

ops-bot: Onboarding checklist created: ID 7893. Assigned to @elaine. ETA 5 days.

samir: Quick ask for onboarding — can infra pre-provision a couple of test nodes (small g5-type) so we can baseline perf before the tenant cutover?

elaine: Will request pre-provisioning in the runbook. Noted.

jon-bizdev: Awesome. Final ask: if anyone has a short one-liner about why Verde picked Redwood (e.g., latency, cost predictability, private deployment options), drop it here — marketing will use it in the case study.

maya: I'll draft the marketing copy after I see the quote.

kevin-sec: I'll attach the BAA and HSM integration checklist to the kickoff invite.

jon-bizdev: Great work — big win for the team. :raised_hands:
